## 3. A native coarse activity envelope

In the catalog the per-site CO adsorption coefficient k_CO is common,
and each undirected neighboring empty pair has the common O2 coefficient
k_pair. Let v(t) be ONLY the total vacancy count. Then

    lambda_CO(t)=k_CO v(t),
    lambda_O2(t)=k_pair E(S_t),                              (4)

where S_t is the unobserved vacancy set and E(S) its induced-edge count.
No diffusion/reaction/desorption rate is needed in (2)--(4).

Every O2 adsorption condition/action is enumerated in `PAIR_GRAPH.json`.
There are32sites,64 distinct edges, and degree4 at every vertex. The
native index2*(x+4y)+type maps to the8-by4 square torus by X=2x+type.
The complete native edge list verifies that map; it is not assumed
from the model name. Counting degrees gives

    max(0,4v-64) <= E(S) <= 2v.                             (5)

For the lower bound, all edges incident on the complement number at
most4(32-v), so E(S)>=64-4(32-v). The upper follows from the4v
incident half-edges. The lower is attained: choose subsets of one
bipartition for v<=16 and use complements for v>=16.

The strongest ordinary SAME-coarse-information pointwise envelope was
also paid. Root's separate `root_vacancy_envelope/` reads all64native
edges and acquires exact E_min(v),E_max(v) by ordinary frontier DP,
with8columns of4sites and16masks per column. Fixing the first mask,
retain last mask, total count, and minimum/maximum accumulated inside
and adjacent-column edge score; add the final periodic cut at closure.
Induction over columns covers every vacancy set exactly. All66extreme
witnesses and41449low-v native subsets were checked. I whole-read its
proof, complete code, and receipt. No repeat dynamics was needed.

E_min equals (5). E_max, for v0..32, is

    [0,0,1,2,4,5,7,9,12,13,15,17,20,21,23,25,28,
     29,31,33,36,37,39,41,44,45,47,49,52,54,57,60,64].

This is a sharp per-v geometric bound, not a sharp dynamic path
envelope. Temporal constraints could further reduce uncertainty and
are not paid. Root's geometry costs are .0767s acquisition and .1476s
verification,270592integer DP transitions. This is a credited ordinary
optimization, not a new algorithm or a microscopic measurement.

Exact coarse-vacancy activity interface for the acquired32-site graph
Root,29Oct2026. Ordinary frontier optimization, not a new algorithm or a
measured kinetic system. InputPAIR_GRAPH.json SHA256
b5c77b688deb8097484f3f81de8cf414284049a9c5e4b9504b4b30b66a2c02c2.

The program reads ALL64 undirected native O2-adsorption edges, checks
distinctness/degree4/common supplied rate, then verifies the8-by4 torus map
with native index X+8Y. No other kinetic channels, hidden-state observations
or physical rate/detector qualification are imported. For vacancy setS,
v=|S|, let E(S) count edges with both ends inS. Under the supplied common
positive-rate model the O2 activity is k_pair*E(S), so optimize INTEGER E.

Construct columns C_X={X+8Y:Y=0..3},X0..7, with16 masks each. Every verified
native edge lies within a column or across consecutive columns modulo8.
All inside/cross costs are derived from the actual edge list. Fix firstmask
s0. After columns0..j, DP_j(last,v) retains the minimum/maximum edge totals
over every partial configuration of that vacancy count and last-column mask.
Count internal edges and cuts between processed columns; defer the7-to0 cut.
Adding masks adds its internal edges and the last-to-new cut. These depend
only on the retained lastmask and newmask. Induction proves the recurrence
covers every partial configuration and discards no state needed for future
cost. At column7 add its cut tos0, then optimize overlast ands0. Every full
configuration is exactly one eight-mask sequence, so min/max are GLOBAL and
EXACT for allv0..32. Attaining witness bitmasks are retained for both extrema.

O(L*M*q^3) time suffices(L8,M32,q16); memory O(Mq) perfirstmask plus finite
cost/witness tables. Actual acquisition:270592 transitions, recorded.0767s;
verification.1476s after imports. No kinetic samples, dynamics or physical
work occurred. These are preparation costs, not a performance advantage.
All66 witness scores/counts were independently checked from the edge list.
The4-regular complement identity E(S)=4v-64+E(S_complement) was checked for
min/max.41449 native subsets(v0..4) were separately enumerated and scored.
The recurrence proof supplies the remaining optimality scope; witnesses or
finite controls alone would not establish global extrema.
